title: Riot Games Creator-Safe Playlist
description: Riot Games' official Spotify playlist: 'This is a collection of music that is 100% owned by Riot Games. It can be used in streams or content creation as long as it follows the "Legal Jibber Jabber" rules on our website.' 979 entries at the trk108 check.

source.entries1to100: official Spotify embed (2026-10-11): 1-20 Season 9, 21-59 Season 8, 60-100 the first 41 tracks of Season 7
source.mirrorNote: Third-party listing (not run by Riot or Spotify), read on 2026-10-12. It shows the playlist in 50-entry blocks, each block sorted by Spotify track ID, and shows 977 of the 979 entries; the 2 it omits are in positions 701-750.
source.crossChecks: The 36 VALORANT rows were re-confirmed one by one by the songdata.io listing of the official VALORANT Creator-Safe Playlist; 3 IDs (Deathfire Grasp, Leilani, For Demacia!) were opened on the official Spotify track embed and showed the same title, artist and cover.

rowsNote: row = songdata.io row number (51-977); id = Spotify track ID; then title and artists as shown. Rows 1-50 (Season 9 and the first 30 tracks of Season 8, matched on the official embed) are not stored. Inside each 50-row block the order is by track ID, not playlist order. Artists for rows 51-250 were not copied row by row: those rows are the Season OST tracks and seven singles, all credited 'League of Legends' (row 250, Vi: 'League of Legends, Nicki Taylor'). Some Wild Rift and Teamfight Tactics tracks appear twice with the same ID (real duplicates in the playlist).
